D/ DN MAGNEN TIVS PF AVG ; R/ FELICITAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius (350-353), emperor left issue of 350-351, Reece period 18, Lyon mint, RIC volume 8 no. 112. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN MAGNEN TIVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing left holding labarum and [globe]. Reverse inscription: FELICITAS REI PVBLICAE. In exergue: RPLG.
